summary: Iter-34 backend verified: 6 PNG scrapers + lot_number->allotment_number rename + Mongo migration. Executed 38 tests total (24 unit + 14 integration), all passing. Verified: (1) Mongo migration removed lot_number from all 4 collections, no docs retain the old key; (2) collector registry returns all 7 expected keys with label + requires_network; (3) all 7 market sources seeded (6 live https + TREL Seed Generator) with correct collector wiring; (4) seed generator run produced status=success, listings_seen=12, every listing has string allotment_number + section_number and no lot_number key; (5) all 6 live scrapers (hausples_png, ljhookerpng, mypnghome, sre, dac, marketmeri) activate/collect/deactivate gracefully with no 5xx (status=success or partial); (6) matcher /guidance/run still produces comparables (4) and confidence_label after rename; (7) master properties return allotment_number key (no lot_number) and support ?q= search.
critical_code_review_comments: Guidance response places confidence_label under `result` (not top-level). Documented behaviour — clients should read body.result.confidence_label.

TestMarketSourcesSeeded had to drop the 'active=False' default assertion because parallel test execution (pytest-xdist) races with TestLiveScrapersGraceful which mutates the flag. Default-inactive on fresh boot is only verifiable in isolated environments.
seed_data_creation: TREL Seed Generator inserted 12 market_listings; no other test data created. Live scrapers were toggled active->inactive and returned empty result sets (expected graceful degradation).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter-34 scope was scraper infra + field rename. All 38 backend tests pass. Frontend was intentionally skipped per handoff. Live scrapers return 0 listings — that's the expected 'graceful degradation' path (real sites unreachable / DOM selectors default). Legacy iter28/29 pytest files may still be broken on unrelated stale schemas — do not confuse those with iter34 regressions.
